evidence_method: Primary public documentation and pinned Git source reads; exact source path/blob recorded where available.
Caller/configuration/build guards and downstream consumers traced for material claims; dormant or unpaired behavior labeled.

review.method: Independent critical review of both research rounds and the complete integrated candidate, followed by lead original-source inspection and deliberate resolution.
review.helpers_requested: GPT-6.1 Terra, max reasoning, per repository helper policy; request is not proof of effective runtime.
dispositions: G04: changed conserved-current-handoff claim to an open parent/pending/active diagnostic; account for caps, damping, external inputs and scatter.
G03: mirror fixture rejects spurious trigger/follower damage, not legitimate transmitted loads.
G01: sensor overlap is not a witness; missing local geometry/shaft data remains unavailable; no low-RPM safety guarantee.
G05/G08/G10/G13/G17: deduplicate request/birth/transition identities while preserving patches, cue layers, paced grains and recontacts.
Shared aftermath source/clock and scene budget remain proposed; existing local pools and adapters do not establish them.
Existing wreck/effects/smoke RNG isolation and audio seed override retained; cross-effect recorded seed is only an optional extension.
G02: distinguish project README GPLv3-or-later statement from inspected GPLv3 source headers.
G11: correct rotor/wet owners; retain current fast-disc interval query and slow phase-proxy limits; YASim rim penetration modifies balance and is not blade CCD.
G11: moving-support equivalence matches relative vectors, geometry, compression, wind and other input frames; unsupported paths use labeled law fixtures.
G12/G13: wreck audio mapped to CR-02c/03c and AUD; person attribution mapped to CR-AUD-30, not geometry/time audit IDs.
G14: contact labels and visual breakup estimates do not prove structural component failure; exact BOS/COB/Recoil pairing unverified.
G15/G16: retain existing smoke fractional timing/rebase behavior; bound catch-up and overflow, preserve event-fraction provenance and allow quality-dependent particle counts.
G17: terminal-water route clears wreck pool; water trajectories are synthetic/future-adapter cases; important body support/wake/anchors survive representation changes.
G18/G20: preserve observed inventory versus estimated release, known source ID versus inferred narrative/attacker, and explicit unknown/refused evidence.
GP-19 instantaneous power is not integrated accepted work; passive diagnostic on/off is distinct from disabling a physical damage law.

Final G17 correction: qualified wreck support/part anchoring/recontact-wake remain proposed requirements; existing live profile-smoke moving emission is not an already-delivered part-following terminal aftermath adapter.
review.final_verdict: No unresolved substantive finding within the reviewed source/documentation scope after G17 correction.

publication_boundary: This branch has divergent older runtime. Publish only the seven documentation paths; future application integration must take the documentation delta, not merge stale source.
